name: Epinephrine (adrenaline)
executiveSummary: Catecholamine. Adult cardiac arrest: **1 mg IV/IO every 3–5 min**. Pediatric arrest: **0.01 mg/kg** (max 1 mg). Anaphylaxis IM: adult **0.3–0.5 mg**; ped **0.01 mg/kg** (max 0.5). Shock infusion: **0.05–1 mcg/kg/min**.
indications:
## Indications

- Cardiac arrest (ACLS/PALS/NRP).
- Anaphylaxis; refractory severe asthma (selected regimens).
- Shock / symptomatic bradycardia with continuous infusion.

## Precautions

- Arrhythmias, hypertension, myocardial ischemia; extravasation → necrosis.
- Distinguish concentrations **1:1000 (1 mg/mL)** vs **1:10,000 (0.1 mg/mL)**.

> In cardiac arrest do not delay epinephrine; prefer IV/IO.

adulto.dose: Arrest: **1 mg IV/IO every 3–5 min**. Anaphylaxis IM: **0.3–0.5 mg** (repeat every 5–15 min). Infusion: **0.05–0.5 mcg/kg/min** (up to **1 mcg/kg/min**) titrated.
adulto.administration: IV/IO in arrest; IM anterolateral thigh in anaphylaxis; infusion via pump (central preferred).
adulto.notes: Monitor ECG, BP, and infusion site.

pediatrico.presentation: Ampule 1 mg/mL; dilute to 0.1 mg/mL for arrest if using 1:1000.
pediatrico.diluent: 0.9% NaCl or D5W for arrest dilution.
pediatrico.finalConcentration: Arrest: **0.1 mg/mL**. Infusion: e.g. **16–32 mcg/mL** (e.g. 0.6 mg in 25–50 mL NS).
pediatrico.dose: Arrest: **0.01 mg/kg IV/IO** (max **1 mg**) every 3–5 min. Anaphylaxis IM: **0.01 mg/kg** (max **0.5 mg**). Infusion: **0.05–1 mcg/kg/min** (usual max **2 mcg/kg/min**).
pediatrico.administration: IV/IO/IM per indication; infusion only via pump.
pediatrico.notes: Do not use if brown/precipitated. Discard remainder.

neonatal.dose: Neonatal CPR: **0.01–0.03 mg/kg IV/IO** (NRP); endotracheal only if no vascular access (**0.05–0.1 mg/kg**). Infusion: **0.05–1 mcg/kg/min**.

stability:
## Stability

- Protect from light. Discard if discolored or precipitated. Pump dilutions: follow local guide (usually 24 h).
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Tachycardia, hypertension, arrhythmias, anxiety, hyperglycemia, necrosis from extravasation.
